verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents templates for retrospectives (docs-9), AI-drafted retrospectives that pull from incident timeline data (docs-13, docs-35, docs-45), collaborative review/editing including permissions and live cursors for Enterprise (docs-10, docs-62, docs-61), and publication via internal/external status pages (docs-15, docs-16, docs-36). This covers the full lifecycle: template → draft from timeline → review → publish. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the postmortem workflow in practice (community evidence is mostly about unrelated topics), and no detail on approval/sign-off steps before formal publication.
